decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-d83aa8e2cc23], is the changelog title "feat!: Logs rbac enforce by default". It marks the change as breaking but never says what happens to principals that currently read logs without an explicit logs permission. The proposed consequence is behavior-change, yet its statement says access "will be denied". That is a lost-access claim, so the kind and the statement contradict each other, and the evidence supports neither. To decide between behavior-change and permission-lost, we need the upgrade guide or the PR #21678 description, saying which roles or policies lose log access and whether any config setting keeps the old behaviour.
